findings.title: depo_fisi_istek adds items to non-bekliyor fiş without a durum guard
findings.evidence: When depo_fisi_id is supplied, the view fetches the fiş and immediately calls DepoFisiKalemi.objects.create() with no check on fis.durum. sessionStorage persists across tabs; if the fiş is approved or cancelled in another tab, the next modal submission will append a kalem to an onaylandi/iptal fiş. The companion depo_fisi_kalem_ekle view (lines 528–529) already applies the correct guard: `if fis.durum != 'bekliyor': return JsonResponse({'basarili': False, ...})`.
findings.consequence: Items are silently added to approved or cancelled receipts, corrupting their state and counts without any error feedback to the user.
findings.correction: Add `if fis.durum != 'bekliyor': return JsonResponse({'basarili': False, 'hata': 'Bu fiş artık bekliyor durumunda değil.'})` immediately after the existing-fiş lookup on line 346, matching the guard already present in depo_fisi_kalem_ekle.
